t: This is the Burgess Park War Memorial, a war memorial in London. It features stained glass, made by Arild Rosenkrantz, and it depicts Jesus Christ. Rosenkrantz was a Danish nobleman who worked as a painter, sculptor, stained glass artist and illustrator, so the memorial carries the hand of an artist who worked across several crafts. Look closely at the figure of Christ and the glass around it, and take a moment to remember the people the memorial honours.
